echo_sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
echo_sets.note: Best-in-slot: maximizes the Aero Erosion mechanic and buffs Rover's own damage via their Resonance Skill conversion.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Healer-support build: team ATK buff plus bonus Energy Regen to keep Liberation healing online.

echo_sets.name: Windward Pilgrimage + Gusts of Welkin
echo_sets.note: While farming a full 5-piece set; keeps Aero DMG and Erosion bonuses online.

build.energy_regen_target: 128–138% (per Prydwen; lower end with Iuno + Ciaccona, higher end with Cartethyia + Ciaccona); on the sub-DPS build, prioritize Crit, Resonance Skill DMG and ATK% once Energy Regen is satisfied.
build.fast_path: Fast path: Bloodpact's Pledge (free from the Chapter 2 Act IV quest) + 5-piece Windward Pilgrimage in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reminiscence: Fleurdelys in the main slot. Crit Rate/Crit DMG 4-cost, Aero DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs. Build Windstrings with mid-air combos, cast Liberation, then Unbound Flow to convert negative statuses into Aero Erosion before Outgoing into your carry.

ranked_weapons.name: Bloodpact's Pledge
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's best-in-slot: a free 5-star tailor-made for Aero Rover — healing boosts Resonance Skill DMG, and Unbound Flow amplifies nearby Resonators' Aero DMG by 10% for 30s.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: Premium 5-star alternative; high ATK and Resonance Skill DMG stacks fit Rover's quick rotations.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen plus stacking ATK on Resonance Skill; strong generalist 5-star option.

ranked_weapons.name: Fables of Wisdom
ranked_weapons.note: 4-star that gains ATK against enemies with negative statuses — exactly the debuffs Rover converts.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% on Intro; accessible standard-pool pick for the quick-swap rotation.

stat_priorities.note: Crit main stat for the sub-DPS build; balance to the 1:2 ratio.
ATK% on both; feeds damage and healing.

profile.role_note: Free Aero Erosion enabler: converts all negative statuses to Aero Erosion and is the only unit that raises the Erosion stack cap (to 6) via Outro, with solid team healing on the side.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free from the Chapter 2 Act IV quest 'The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier' — there's nothing to pull. If you run Cartethyia or any Aero Erosion team, Aero Rover is the free support; outside those teams they have little to do.

sources.record: Rover (Aero) Best Builds and How to Unlock
Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: Premier Aero Erosion DPS; her Inherent Skill has a special interaction that adds Windstring generation to Rover's Liberation.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Premium Aero Erosion sub-DPS; amplifies Aero DMG and Erosion DMG for the whole team.

members.name: Aero Rover
members.note: Raises the Erosion stack cap to 6 with their Outro, converts negative statuses, and heals the team.

teams.name: Premium: Cartethyia + Ciaccona + Aero Rover
teams.rotation: Aero Rover opens with two Cloudburst Dance rotations to build 100 Windstrings, casts Liberation, then Unbound Flow to convert debuffs into Erosion — Outro raises the stack cap as Cartethyia enters to run her Fleurdelys rotations with Ciaccona's Erosion amps layered underneath.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Takes the on-field carry slot here; her full combos deal the team's damage while Ciaccona and Aero Rover support her.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Provides Aero DMG and Aero Erosion amps from her kit and Gusts of Welkin.

members.name: Aero Rover
members.note: General Aero support: heals via Cloudburst Dance and Liberation, raises the Erosion stack cap, and procs Rejuvenating Glow-style support value if built as healer.

teams.name: Alternative: Iuno + Ciaccona + Aero Rover
teams.rotation: Ciaccona opens to apply Erosion stacks, Aero Rover converts and raises the cap while healing, then Iuno takes extended on-field time with her full combos under both supports' Aero DMG amps.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates them A overall (S in Tower of Adversity) and Beebom's October 2026 3.7 tier list places them at A — the only unit that raises the Aero Erosion stack cap, making them the free backbone of every Cartethyia team; niche outside Erosion comps.

sequences.verdict: Partially verified: all six nodes confirmed via wuthering.gg; the S3 best-value pick rests on a single guide, and the chain is earned free through story and events.

nodes.name: Glimmers Fade into the Dark
nodes.effect: Unbound Flow heals the on-field Resonator (20% ATK/3s for 30s); emergency heal below 35% HP.

nodes.name: Boundaries Shatter in an Instant
nodes.effect: Cloudburst Dance grants +15% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 5s.

pull_path.why: Core Erosion enabler kit complete with zero dupes.
Unbound Flow becomes a real heal-over-time for the on-field character.
Flat +15% Aero DMG Bonus lifts his whole rotation.
Unbound Flow multiplier +30% - earned free through story and events.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Signature Bloodpact's Pledge is a luxury - free swords cover his support role; pull it only if Rover is your main DPS.
